changes.comment: Team creation no longer fabricates a synthetic default TeamLeader prompt and auto-fires a turn. Previously `team.create` without an explicit `prompt` built a `"You are the TeamLeader…"` string and immediately submitted it, so a freshly created leader ran one throwaway turn before any real work or channel binding existed. Now the leader is started (it still gets a resumable session at start) and left idle; its first turn comes from a bound channel inbound, a dispatcher `send`, or an explicit `prompt` supplied at create time. The optional `team.create` `prompt` param is unchanged and still delivered as the leader's first turn when present. The `team.create` result `turn` is now `null` when no `prompt` was supplied.
